Love this app. I have a 2.5 month old daughter who has fought bedtime since she was born. This app has been amazing! We use the womb sounds for her since the start and it has really helped to sooth her. And honestly, when I’m struggling to fall asleep myself this helps me as well since I’ve grown so used to it playing! I love the ocean and thunderstorm sounds as well. It’s neat that they have many different choices, as well as lullabies and classical music, something for everyone!! 

Last week I finally decided I wanted the sounds to last longer than the free version-a continuous sound for her at night so I purchased the full version. However, being a sleep deprived mom of 4 kids I didn’t know why it wasn’t letting me do continuous play, only giving me the free version 1 hour. So Last night I sent a message to the app’s help line which was super easy to do, and asked for help. The creator promptly reached out within a few hours, in the middle of the night (it was 130am here) to help me out. Within a few emails back and forth he helped me with where I was messing up. 

Turns out it was my user error being so tired not realizing it was so simple to slide the dial on the sound timer to continuous from where it was! Silly me! Michael was so kind and helpful throughout the exchange during the middle of the night! I definitely highly recommend this to anyone with young babies/children, and even to use for yourself when you just need a calming break from the hustle and bustle of life! Thank you for creating a wonderful sound app!

This app is amazing and I will never stop using it!
